supplemental_items.interpretation: Require valid nonempty main interval before indexing. The lower interval is bisect-left at both ends, excluding the boundary even when multiple equal-time rows exist. New local records and chronology use original dynamic type and integer total seconds. Visible bounds may express no overlap; this helper does not enforce visible nonemptiness. Explicit non-null trend overrides are retained independently, otherwise original flags only at start zero.
